groups.title: Corner notchers · value line
groups.lead: Hydraulic and pneumatic corner notchers — NovoTech value line, built in China.

intro_add: NovoTech's value-line notchers, built in China, add the HNM-6 and HNM-6A hydraulic notchers for 1/4″ and the PNM-130 and PNM-150 pneumatic notchers for sheet to 1/8″.
points_add: NovoTech value line: HNM-6 / HNM-6A hydraulic 1/4″, PNM-130 / PNM-150 pneumatic

faq_add.a: A hydraulic notcher cuts 3/16 – 1/4″ plate quickly and is the choice for a production shop or for heavier plate; a pneumatic notcher runs on shop air and cuts up to 1/8″ in sheet — quieter, no hydraulic oil, a lower price. The premium-line HNM notchers and the value-line HNM-6 / HNM-6A differ in build and price; both have adjustable stops and a sheet hold-down.

set.hero_brand_line: Premium-line corner notchers are built in Turkey to NovoTech's specification with European hydraulic and electrical components; the value-line notchers are built in China to NovoTech's specification. All sold with a 1-year warranty and supported from Mississauga, ON, Canada.
